description.zh:
快照类型。取值范围：

- Standard：标准快照。
- Flash：本地快照。
- Archive：归档快照。

默认值：Standard。
description.en:
The type of the snapshot. Valid values:

- Standard: standard snapshot

- Flash: local snapshot

- Archive: archive snapshot

Default value: Standard.

description.zh: 获取快照容量变化数据的结束时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是 00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is rounded up to the next minute.

description.zh:
获取快照容量变化数据的间隔时间，单位为秒。取值范围：

- 60
- 600
- 3600

默认值：60。
description.en:
The interval at which to query the monitoring data of snapshot sizes. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 60

- 600

- 3600

Default value: 60.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 获取快照容量变化数据的起始时间点。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如果指定的秒（ss）不是 00，则自动换算为下一分钟。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If the value of seconds (ss) is not 00, the time is rounded up to the next minute.

title.zh: 查询近30天内快照容量变化监控数据

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

调用该接口时，您需要注意：

-  一次最多返回400条数据，需满足`（EndTime–StartTime）/Period`小于等于400的条件限制，即返回参数`TotalCount`不能超过400，否则将返回`InvalidParameter.TooManyDataQueried`的错误提示。  

- 一次最多能查询近30天内的监控信息，即指定的参数`StartTime`距今不能超过30天。
descriptions.en:
## [](#)Usage notes

Take note of the following items:

- Up to 400 monitoring data entries can be returned at a time. Make sure that the `TotalCount` value does not exceed 400. The value is calculated by using the following formula: `TotalCount = (EndTime - StartTime)/Period`. If the TotalCount value is greater than 400, the `InvalidParameter.TooManyDataQueried` error is returned.

- You can query the monitoring data of snapshot sizes in the last 30 days. If the value of `StartTime` is more than 30 days earlier than the current time, an error is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-snapshot-monitor-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2019-05-10T00:00:00Z --end-time 2019-05-10T03:00:00Z --period 60 --category Standard --region cn-hangzhou
